The user wants to implement automatic detection and restart of the LSP server if it crashes or becomes unresponsive.
I have two completed jobs:
T1: Found that detection is reactive via `health ok` probe (HTTP GET) and restart is triggered by `start completion server` (which calls `stop owned unlocked` and relaunches). This happens on every `ensure completion server` call (e.g., when sending a request), not via an independent watchdog timer.
T2: Confirmed there is NO periodic watchdog timer for LSP. Detection is reactive via `transport reader eof` (EOF in pipe) and restart is manual/debounced after config changes (`schedule debounced lsp restart`).

The anchor claim is: "necesito que si el proceso del servidor de lenguaje LSP se cae o deja de responder, la aplicación lo detecte automáticamente y lo reinicie sin que el usuario tenga que hacer nada"

Current state:
- Detection exists reactively (on request via `health ok`, or on pipe EOF).
- Restart exists reactively (on request via `ensure completion server`).
- There is NO periodic watchdog.
- The user wants automatic detection and restart without user action.
